title: King of the Route
bio: Tricycle driver who plays as fast as he drives. No signal, no brakes, and never any change.

player_low_cards: Almost there, close to the split. I mean, the win.
Fast, ha. Like cutting across the corner.
Still riding along? You're about to get dropped off, kid.
self_low_cards: One more fare and I'm off.
Almost at the terminal. Don't stop me.
self_winning_soon: Just one! I'm full, let's roll!
A win. Everybody off, end of the route.
At the terminal now. No turning back!
got_ipit: Hoy! You cut me off like a counterflow!
Blocked me?! That's a traffic violation, kid!
Aray. Sudden brake, no signal at all!
played_big_combo: Five cards. Overloaded, but still running!
Combo! Like five passengers squeezed in. Too many, but it works.
Five! The trike's packed, no more room!
